description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) of the MADLLM model and its ablated variants across six different datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score ranging from 60% to 100%, with tick marks at 10% intervals. Each dataset on the horizontal axis is represented by four grouped bars, corresponding to four configurations: MADLLM (green), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple), pool (blue), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (orange). For SMD, all four variants perform similarly, with F1 scores around 91–93%. On PSM, MADLLM achieves the highest score (~97%), followed closely by MADLLM w/o feature embedding (~96%), while pool drops to ~77% and MADLLM w/o skip embedding remains high at ~95%. For SWaT, MADLLM and MADLLM w/o feature embedding score ~91% and ~90%, respectively, pool is at ~83%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding is ~85%. SMAP shows a notable drop: MADLLM scores ~93%, MADLLM w/o feature embedding ~70%, pool ~69%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding ~67%. MSL follows a similar pattern: MADLLM ~87%, MADLLM w/o feature embedding ~85%, pool ~69%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding ~85%. WADI shows the lowest performance overall: MADLLM ~74%, MADLLM w/o feature embedding ~62%, pool ~64%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding ~68%. The chart visually emphasizes that removing feature embedding or skip embedding generally degrades performance, especially on SMAP and WADI, while the full MADLLM model consistently achieves the highest or near-highest scores across all datasets.
